Comprehensive covers both vehicles i.e. 3rd party+you.

First we will have to understand both insurance by definition 

Third-Party Car Insurance

As per The Motor Vehicles Act, third-party insurance is mandatory while driving a vehicle in India. It reimburses the third-parties for losses/damages caused by the insured four-wheeler.

Comprehensive Car Insurance

Comprehensive Insurance offers extensive coverage that covers Third-party Liabilities and Own Damage. Buying this type of policy is not mandatory by law, 

Hence, due to enhanced coverage of comprehensive insurance , it is the preferred choice for many owners.

I prefer to take comprehensive over third party even it's costlier 😊🙋
